scenarios.title: Two Abhyasis race for the last sitting place
scenarios.intent: Two eligible Abhyasis attempt to book the same remaining place concurrently; the total bookings never exceed capacity.
scenarios.technique_notes: Concurrency, state_flow, idempotency-risk assessment: same slot contention, not speculative retry semantics. EQP: capacity 1/default versus capacity greater than 1; numeric default is not a stated boundary so BVA is inapplicable. auth/data-loss risk requests strength=3; covering_array produced all eight link × visibility × occupancy triples, but the four-pair ceiling prioritizes distinct outcomes rather than eight redundant executions. No API endpoint or synchronization mechanism is specified.

scenarios.title: Book a visible sitting from linked preceptors in local time
scenarios.intent: A linked Abhyasi sees eligible open slots from two linked preceptors in their timezone and books one instantly without approval.
scenarios.technique_notes: EQP valid linked/visible/space-remaining input; state_flow valid transition to booking; timezone conversion uses UTC instant as oracle. Strength=3 (auth/data-loss risk); covering_array's eligible open combinations can be swept as parameters without assuming a concrete date or slot count. Additional dedicated timezone and multi-preceptor paths were budget-evicted.

capacity_classes: group capacity greater than 1 with space

scenarios.title: Exclude inaccessible sitting slots
scenarios.intent: In a slot view with a known accessible control slot, slots of unlinked preceptors and slots restricted to another Abhyasi do not appear.
scenarios.technique_notes: Negative/auth EQP: inaccessible unlinked versus linked but restricted to someone else are equivalent forbidden outcomes swept as parameters. Strength=3 because visibility is access-sensitive; covering_array's unlinked and restricted classes are represented, not a claim of complete 3-wise execution under the ceiling.

inaccessible_classes: slot restricted to another Abhyasi by a linked preceptor

scenarios.title: Exclude a full sitting slot
scenarios.intent: When a slot has reached its configured capacity, it is not offered in the Abhyasi's open-slot view.
scenarios.technique_notes: Negative/EQP: capacity reached versus remaining space; covers the negative occupancy family separately from authorization. BVA not applied: capacity 1 is a default, not a stated minimum or maximum. Strength=3 due to capacity integrity and access risk; covering_array's linked/full combination is represented.

question.prompt: Should a separate multi-preceptor view scenario be restored by raising the four-pair ceiling?

options.label: Keep combined coverage
options.detail: The successful booking scenario checks slots from multiple linked preceptors.

options.label: Raise ceiling
options.detail: Add a dedicated multi-preceptor pair later.

gaps.risk_rationale: Rank 55: a dedicated journey is omitted under max_pairs=4; combined happy path still exercises the multi-preceptor invariant.

question.prompt: Should a separate timezone scenario be restored by raising the four-pair ceiling?

options.label: Keep combined coverage
options.detail: The successful booking journey checks the viewer's timezone.

options.label: Raise ceiling
options.detail: Add a dedicated timezone pair later.

gaps.risk_rationale: Rank 52: dedicated timezone journey omitted under max_pairs=4; combined happy path still exercises timezone conversion.

judgements.rationale: 98: last-place race protects capacity integrity and is unique among candidates.
91: core flow tests booking plus linked-preceptor and timezone visibility.
88: negative access case catches leakage of hidden and unlinked slots.
85: negative occupancy case protects the meaning of open slots.
55: dedicated linked-preceptor journey is redundant with s2; budget-evicted.
52: dedicated timezone journey is redundant with s2; budget-evicted.
